title: Border Beam
desc: Animated border beam for Jetpack Compose, drawn by an AGSL shader.
long: A beautifully animated border beam for Jetpack Compose. One AGSL shader pass draws the beam and its glow, so there are no blur layers. Wrap a text field, button, card or any composable, pick a shape and a palette, and drive the beam from focus or loading state. Android 13 and up use the shader; older versions use a lighter Canvas fallback.
params: BeamStyle.large (comet with a soft glow), small (tight ring) or line (sweeps along the bottom edge). Default large.
BeamShape.rounded(r) in dp, capsule or circle. Default rounded(26).
Fades the beam in and out, then stops the frame loop so an idle beam costs nothing. Default true.
Any List<Color>, up to 8. The first color is the tail and the last is the head. BeamPalette has colorful, gemini, spectrum, neon, sunset, aurora, silver, mono and single(color).
BeamTiming with rotateDuration (2.4 s), lineDuration (2.0 s) and fade (0.6 s). BeamSpeed(x) { } changes the speed of every beam inside.
Container only. Background fill (null for none) and hairline border.
Container only. Standard Modifier and the composable you wrap. Modifier.borderBeam(...) draws only the beam.
meta: AGSL on Android 13+, Canvas fallback below
